issues_found.issue: The checkpoint download failed late when the host filesystem had only 226 MiB free.
issues_found.fix: Add an early disk-space preflight with local-checkpoint and HF_HOME guidance.

issues_found.issue: vLLM 0.30.0 selected FlashInfer sampling on SM120 and failed its architecture check.
issues_found.fix: Default VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 and use native sampling.

issues_found.issue: Serial benchmark latency included time waiting behind the semaphore.
issues_found.fix: Start request timing only after acquiring the semaphore and add a regression test.
